name: solana-mcp-vybe
description:
Solana MCP by Vybe is a developer toolkit for live Solana data: wallets, trades, markets, transfers, and signable swaps. Ask for wallet balances, PnL, holdings, prices, holders, liquidity, and candles; scan markets, trades, and transfers; or pull top traders and labeled accounts.

Each tool calls one Vybe API endpoint. Build-swap, build-close-token-accounts, and build-withdraw-mev return an unsigned transaction to sign in your own wallet. It does not take private keys or broadcast transactions.
